performance.cost_note: Timed in-function estimate including extraction, validation, analysis and their uploads; excludes startup, final-report upload tail, image builds, transfer charges, storage and credits. Not invoice cost.

terminal_token_audit.method: Offline deterministic reconstruction with exact tokenizer fingerprint, every normalized-record hash, and every extraction token count verified; no raw-token GCS fetch

interpretation: Descriptive selected-depth rankings and correlations. Same-token subsets change corpus composition and are sensitivity analyses, not causal punctuation interventions. Prior BERT ratio is a different, scale-sensitive isolated-line measurement. No novelty, literary-validity, significance, or incremental-value claim.
